name: Short Tipwing
description: Pinch one wing tip with the bent elbow of the stick facing your palm and hold it firm.

name: Arctrot
description: Plant the feet a shoulder apart with the throwing side back so the body can turn into the cast.

name: Wooddrop
description: Bring the stick back beside the ear and snap it forward on a flat plane at head height.

name: Open Trailingedge
description: A sharp wrist snap at release makes the stick spin fast enough to keep its flat line in the air.

name: Calm Crookend
description: Watch the returning arc and clap both hands together on the stick as it sinks level with the chest.

name: Watching Leadingedge
description: Raise a wet thumb and feel which side cools first then tilt the next throw into that breeze.

name: Downward Curveback
description: Squeeze the wing tip with a palm toughened by drills so the stick does not slip at release.

name: Returnhit
description: Throw the stick at a hanging sack over and over until the palm skin stops blistering from the spin.

name: Blunt Cycle
description: Throw hard and flat at a post a few paces off and learn how far the stick bites.

name: Barkdash
description: Drop into a crouch and send the stick skimming just above the dirt at a low target.

name: Quiet Hover
description: Slide one step toward the landing line so the stick comes down into your reach.

name: Returnstrike
description: Push off the rear foot as the arm swings so the whole body lends its strength to the throw.

name: Gnawing Wingarm
description: Rotate the hips before the shoulder and let the stick leave the hand as the chest squares up.

name: Open Returnarc
description: Hold the stick cocked behind a braced shoulder then lob it high so it drops steeply on the mark.

name: Firm Return
description: Tilt the throwing plane upward so the stick climbs and then falls onto a distant target.

name: Upward Circling
description: Cant the stick a few fingers off vertical so the flight curves around a post toward the target.

name: Ready Woodgrain
description: Hold the stick short and turn a jab aside with the flat of its heavy arm.

name: Wide Arc
description: Grip one arm and rap an opponent's forearm with the other arm like a short club.

name: Leaden Trailingedge
description: Draw the wrist back until the tendons tighten and then let them spring the stick away.

name: Blunt Loopback
description: Roll the forearm outward as the fingers open so the spin starts before the stick is clear.

name: Blunt Woodgrain
description: Drag the thumb pad along the wing edge a moment longer to slow the spin for a short hovering throw.

name: Upward Elbowbend
description: Peel the stick off the fingertips one finger at a time to put a fast clean rotation on it.

name: Arcdrop
description: Whip the arm across the body and twist the wrist off the stick for a flat cutting flight.

name: Hoverhit
description: Pull the stick from the belt loop and send it away in one unbroken motion.

name: Gnawing Sweptwing
description: Hold the stick backward and drag the inner elbow across an opponent's wrist or ankle.

name: Graincowl
description: Carry the stick flat before the face and keep it there to blunt thrown stones.

name: Quick Sweptwing
description: Heft the thick hunting stick by one end and fling it flat and low with no thought of its return.

name: Curveskitter
description: Creep forward on bent knees with the stick tucked close until the quarry is inside throwing range.

name: Hoverblow
description: Lock the arm bones straight at the elbow and send the stick out in a hard level line.

name: Downward Circling
description: Skim the stick at knee height through a flock on the ground to catch one in the legs.

name: Curvenote
description: Part the grass with the stick tip and trace the line from your eye to the hidden quarry.

name: Hard Returnarc
description: Throw the stick against a tree trunk so it glances off and strikes a target on the far side.

name: Quick Hover
description: Hold the stick in a palm warmed by one slow breath of circulating qi.

name: Arcdash
description: Let a thread of qi ride the stick from palm to fingertip and let go at its peak.

name: Upward Return
description: Feed a steady trickle of qi into the rotation so the stick keeps its speed through the whole loop.

name: Tending Wingarm
description: Cushion the returning stick with a pad of qi in both palms so it settles instead of stinging.

name: Hard Arc
description: Slow the stick with a touch of qi at the far end so it pauses and then swings home.

name: Straight Cycle
description: Throw with a gentle upward tilt and a long wrist roll to open the return into a broad loop.

name: Short Curveback
description: Pinch the wing tip with qi tight in the fingers and peel it away cleanly at the last instant.

name: Low Crookend
description: Tip the stick left and keep qi flowing into the lower wing so the flight leans around a corner.

name: Stiff Returnarc
description: Mirror the left bank and tilt right so the stick curves behind a post or a standing target.

name: Curvebump
description: Pitch the stick steeply up so it tops out high overhead and settles back into the thrower's reach.

name: Woodtrot
description: Take two quick steps under the falling stick so you stand directly beneath its return.

name: Barkreview
description: Glance at the grass tips and the dust to learn how hard the wind will push the loop.

name: Tending Elbowbend
description: Turn the stick in the light and judge which wing arm will lift hardest when thrown.

name: Square Leadingedge
description: Set the fingers along the rounded edge so the sharp edge cuts the air and leads the spin.

name: Curvedash
description: Throw with the wind at your back and a flatter tilt so the stick carries much farther.

name: Returnbump
description: Throw low and hard into a wind and let a steady thread of qi hold the spin against it.

name: Tipwing Strike
description: Wrap a thin qi spiral around each wing arm so the stick spins truer and holds its plane.

name: Deep Sweptwing
description: Time the stick's descent and take it between both palms with a quick inward squeeze.

name: Holding Elbowbend
description: Turn an incoming blow with the hardened wing edge and a brief flicker of qi in the wrist.

name: Circling Hit
description: Hook the inner elbow around an opponent's wrist and pull sharply to drag the arm off line.

name: Judging Leadingedge
description: Fix the eye on a distant post then lift the stick to the same height and point along the line.

name: Gnawing Crookend
description: Swing the throwing arm in a wide backward circle to gather speed before the cast leaves the hand.

name: Low Hover
description: Keep qi trickling into the stick through the whole outward flight so its spin does not fade.

name: Descending Loopback
description: Pivot the stick at the far end with a small qi nudge so the turn is wide and unhurried.

name: Cycle Skitter
description: Stroll toward the stick's landing point at a steady pace so you arrive just as it does.

name: Mild Curveback
description: Reach up and close the hand on a stick passing overhead using a flash of qi in the fingers.

name: Smooth Wingarm
description: Hold the hand open and cupped at belt height to take the returning stick on its flat.

name: Watching Woodgrain
description: Close thumb and finger across the elbow of the stick as it slows and hangs.

name: Grainlid
description: Clap a thin film of qi between both palms and stop the stick with a loud flat slap.

name: Hoverhop
description: Step back as the stick lands in the palm so its speed bleeds away through the legs.

name: Warm Woodgrain
description: Close the eyes and follow the thrum of the spinning stick to find where it will come down.
